player_prompt.intro:
I ni Colonel Blotto-ah {role} i ni.
I tihtak chu round tam zawk a chak.
Round reng reng ah, {num_total_units} units i pe ang a, fields {field_names} ah.
Field khat ah unit tam zawk pe tu hian field chu a chak a, field tam zawk a chak tu hian round a chak.
Example ah, '[A7 B7 C6]' hian A ah 7 units, B ah 7 units, C ah 6 units a pe.
